import numpy as np

M_phi = np.eye(3)

M_d = np.diag([
    0.30, 0.30, 0.30,
    0.30, 0.30, 0.30,
    0.00, 0.00, 0.00,
])

C_N = 0.50 * np.eye(3)
C_M = 0.25 * np.eye(3)

v_phi_n = np.array([0.10, -0.05, 0.02])

v_d_n = np.array([
    0.01, -0.01, 0.02,
    -0.015, 0.008, 0.012,
    0.004, -0.003, 0.002,
])

N_n = np.array([0.20, -0.10, 0.05])
M_n = np.array([0.03, 0.04, -0.02])

v_phi_np1 = v_phi_n.copy()
v_d_np1 = v_d_n.copy()
N_np1 = N_n.copy()
M_np1 = M_n.copy()

directors = np.eye(3)

omega_b = np.array([0.20, 0.00, 0.00])

v_d_boundary = np.concatenate([
    np.cross(omega_b, directors[0]),
    np.cross(omega_b, directors[1]),
    np.cross(omega_b, directors[2]),
])

v_phi_boundary = np.zeros(3)

n_boundary = np.array([0.40, -0.20, 0.10])
m_boundary = np.array([1.31, 0.00, 0.00])

h = 0.50
assert np.allclose(compute_energy_balance_defect(
    M_phi,
    M_d,
    C_N,
    C_M,
    v_phi_n,
    v_d_n,
    N_n,
    M_n,
    v_phi_np1,
    v_d_np1,
    N_np1,
    M_np1,
    directors,
    v_d_boundary,
    v_phi_boundary,
    n_boundary,
    m_boundary,
    h,
), target)
